en.name: Ballistic Armor Co. Bastion helmet (M81 US Woodland)
en.description: The Bastion NIJ level IIIA tactical helmet designed for law enforcement and civilian use. Equipped with M-LOK interface rails for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Ballistic Armor Co. M81 US Woodland version.
